summary.text: Donald Kanfer is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Webster Barnaby.
A large animal veterinarian who has lived in Volusia County for more than 40 years, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that insurance costs and housing affordability are central concerns.

paragraphs.text: Kanfer graduated from East Meadow High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Reno in 1972, and received an M.D. from the University of Parma in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.
His listed career experience is as a veterinarian.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kanfer said he has lived in the DeLand area since 1986 and raised his family there.

He listed involvement in his Rotary club, county and state veterinary associations, and prior service as a supervisor on the Volusia Soil and Water Conservation District, and said he had twice before been a candidate for county council.
He named insurance costs, housing affordability, and the degradation of the environment, including growth and traffic, as his key campaign messages.
He also said he is passionate about preserving local communities and the environment and about limiting state interference in county and municipal government decisions.
